headline: Benchmarks with inactives and PLM embeddings target enzyme and protein function prediction
label: Enzyme Function Benchmarks And Plms
summary: New benchmarks with validated negatives and ESM2-based classification test how well models predict enzyme and protein function beyond curated positives.
synthesis: The dominant thread is evaluation and prediction of protein function with curated, bias-aware data. MCDBench supplies 792 medium-chain dehydrogenase enzyme-substrate-cofactor combinations that include validated inactives, enabling comparison of four predictors of catalytic performance with negatives represented. PhageLysClass applies ESM2 embeddings in a hierarchical classifier to recognize phage lytic proteins and separate endolysins, an evidence-aware sequence-based function assignment. HiFiPL-Bench is a looser fit: it addresses protein-ligand scoring functions rather than sequence-based enzyme function, but shares the emphasis on fidelity-first, bias-aware benchmarks built from PDB and BindingDB and used to diagnose nine methods. What is new is the focus on diagnostic benchmark design, including negative cases and bias control, alongside protein language model embeddings.
